The module map is part of the lasting root architecture guide. Edit
`module-map.dot`, then run `dot -Tsvg tools/architecture/module-map.dot -o
tools/architecture/module-map.svg`. Keep the requests, returned values and file
names aligned with current code. The temporary refactor tour uses the same SVG.
These developer files are excluded from the distributed R source package.
